name: docs affected --since <ref>
description: List entries whose anchors/paths changed in the diff but whose entry was not updated. Used by the Stop hook and CI.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged b5cefdd. docs affected [--since ref=HEAD] [--strict] [--json]: a hint is hit when the diff overlaps an anchor's span (located in the ref's version), the anchored file was deleted or renamed, or a when.paths entry covers a changed file. A hit is dropped when the entry's content changed in the diff, or when its updated/created is not earlier than the hit file's change time (uncommitted files use their last write time, so docs touch clears the hit; commits use author time). Exit 0, or 1 under --strict. For #34: Stop with --since HEAD only sees uncommitted work, so record the session's starting HEAD at SessionStart and pass it. Cap 'matched' in hook messages. For CI, pass the merge base.
